observation.visible_scene: An aerial/side view of an active volcanic cone set against snow-dusted hills. A crater at the summit holds a glowing orange-red lava lake, and a bright incandescent lava channel spills over the near rim and flows down the dark slope of the cone. A plume of pale grey steam/smoke rises from the crater and drifts toward the right side of the frame. The dominant dynamic element is a lava fountain erupting from the right-central part of the crater, with scattered spatter glowing on the left side of the lake.
visible_changes: The central lava fountain is already active at the first frame as a low, rounded mound; it steadily grows taller and more bulbous through the early frames, reaching its maximum height and most irregular, spiky top around the middle of the excerpt.
After peaking, the fountain subsides: its height decreases and its shape flattens back toward the lake surface in the later frames, with the spatter pattern shifting.
Near the end of the excerpt a new mound of lava begins to rise again on the right side of the crater, growing into a pointed column by the last frame.
The glowing lava channel on the front slope remains continuously bright and in the same position throughout, with only minor texture/spatter changes along its edges.
The steam/smoke plume continuously changes shape and density, drifting rightward over the cone and background, partially veiling the right rim.
The dark cone, crater outline, and snow-covered background hills stay fixed in position across all frames.
outside_clip_unknowns: The onset of the eruption and the final outcome after the last frame are not shown; the fountain was already in motion at the start and is still active at the end.
The volume of lava, vent structure below the surface, and any events before/after this cropped segment are unseen.
uncertain_details: Camera motion is not clearly evidenced; background landmarks appear stationary, so any drift or zoom is uncertain and treated as minimal.
Exact material identity of the glowing flow (lava vs. incandescent spatter) and the precise cause of the fountain's pulsing are not determinable from the frames alone.
